subject: SIG kickoff & SOC 2 scope — clarifying items and prefill next steps
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Morales <ava@luminova.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@luminova.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG kickoff & SOC 2 scope — clarifying items and prefill next steps

Thanks again for your time this morning — great to hear about the Luminova roadmap and the timeline for pilot evaluation. Quick recap and a few clarifying asks so we can get the SIG/CAIQ prefill started: 

1) SOC 2 status: you mentioned SOC 2 Type II in progress with an expected completion in Q1 2027. Can you confirm whether the current controls are in place for the data retention and encryption controls (CC6/CC9 equivalents)? If you have a one-page SOC 2 snapshot or target timeline, that would help us map evidence.

2) Data classification & PHI scope: you indicated only metadata and de-identified outputs will be sent during the pilot, but there may be PHI in later integrations. For the SIG prefills, should we treat the scope as "pilot (non-PHI)" or "future PHI-in-scope"? This changes hosting/evidence asks (e.g., BAA, logging retention).

3) Hosting & residency: confirm whether Luminova will require EU residency for any production traffic during the pilot or is US-only for now. If EU is required, we’ll route to our EU-hosted model variants and flag encryption-at-rest evidence for the SIG accordingly.

4) Preferred questionnaire: do you want us to send a SIG Lite (fast path), the full SIG, or the CAIQ? We can prefill either; SIG Lite typically closes faster for pilots, but some procurement teams insist on the full SIG.

Next steps I propose: I’ll attach a suggested SIG prefill workbook with the items we can fill from our side (SOC 2 summary, encryption details, network architecture stub). If you can drop a fill for the points above and a preferred ESR contact for evidence uploads, we’ll turn around a prefilled packet within 3 business days.

Attachments: Luminova_SIG_prefill.xlsx (stub) — contains tabs for scope, hosting, and evidence checklist.

Thanks —
Dylan
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
(d) 415-555-0123 | dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

From: Ava Morales <ava@luminova.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@luminova.ai>
Date: 2026-08-27T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG kickoff & SOC 2 scope — clarifying items and prefill next steps

Dylan — thanks for the clear recap and the workbook. Quick answers below: 

1) SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type I in May 2026; Type II audit fieldwork starts in November 2026 with an anticipated report in March 2027. We do have a "controls snapshot" PDF that lists implemented controls; I can share that.

2) PHI scope: For the pilot we will only send pseudonymized records (no direct identifiers). However, we intend to evaluate a HIPAA-covered integration in production later this year. For the SIG please mark scope as "pilot — pseudonymized (non-PHI) with future PHI-in-scope". We'll follow up with timeline for PHI production.

3) Residency: Pilot is US-only. EU residency may be required for a larger roll-out in 2027, but not for now.

4) Questionnaire preference: Procurement prefers SIG Lite to move quickly, but security has asked for the full SIG if we get past the pilot. For now, please send SIG Lite prefill and we'll indicate willingness to upgrade to full SIG later.

Contact for uploads: Samir Patel (samir.patel@luminova.ai). He is the security ops lead and will own evidence collection.

I’ll attach the SOC snapshot and a quick network diagram. Expect Samir to upload any additional evidence to your shared Drive link.

Thanks —
Ava
Head of Product — Luminova
ava@luminova.ai

Looping in a couple of practical asks from our side to reduce back-and-forth during evidence collection: 

- If you select SIG Lite, please confirm whether any custom questions (procurement-specific) are required. SIG Lite covers most standard controls, but custom procurement fields slow things down.

- For SOC 2 snapshot: if you can share the control mapping (which control families are in scope) we can map evidence to our prefill workbook faster. A PDF is fine.

- Evidence upload format: Samir, we typically accept zipped folders named by evidence type (e.g., "encryption_at_rest_2026.zip"). If you have a preferred metadata file format (CSV of evidence items + owners), send it and we will accommodate.

I’ve attached a one-page SOC2 summary (Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf) — happy to mark any rows we can fill from our side. 

Thanks —
Marissa

1) Dylan: Prepare SIG Lite prefill (we'll fill all standard Redwood responses, mark "pilot scope" per Ava) — deliverable: prefilled SIG Lite workbook (attached) by 2026-08-30 COB.
2) Samir: Share SOC snapshot & control mapping + any initial evidence zips to the Drive link. If you can drop an evidence CSV, that speeds matching.
3) Marissa/Kimberly: We’ll review the SOC snapshot when Samir uploads and flag any gaps tied to HIPAA/PHI readiness.

Next meeting: propose a 30-min sync on 2026-09-02 to walk through the prefill and evidence handoff (I’ll send a calendar once Samir confirms availability).

Attachments (sent): Luminova_SIG_prefill.xlsx, Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf
